payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into what the model learns in a zero-shot setting, particularly in cross-lingual transfer learning for reading comprehension tasks.

claims.text: In a zero-shot setting, the model learns to identify answer spans in context, albeit with less accuracy compared to models fine-tuned on the target language.
The model encodes semantic and syntactic information in a language-agnostic way, allowing for effective zero-shot transfer between languages with low lexical similarity.
The model demonstrates the ability to perform zero-shot learning on various natural language understanding tasks, including reading comprehension.
